tweets.text:
PAISAS GANG MEMBER ASSAULTS AGENT — ARRESTED!

LAREDO, TX – A self-proclaimed Paisas gang member became combative during an arrest conducted by Laredo PD and U.S. Border Patrol. When the situation escalated, a Border Patrol agent quickly deployed a less-lethal device to regain control and protect himself.

The subject, a Mexican national, has an extensive criminal record that includes:
•             Robbery
•             Resisting arrest
•             Possession of a controlled substance
•             Child endangerment
•             14 prior immigration arrests
•             6 removals from the U.S.

He now faces federal prosecution for felony illegal re-entry under 8 U.S.C. §1326.
👉 Let this serve as a warning: Violence against our agents will not be tolerated. Those who choose aggression will face force — and justice.

tweets.text:
CHILD PREDATOR ARRESTED IN LOS ANGELES!

June 3 — A Salvadoran national with an active Interpol Red Notice was arrested in Los Angeles, CA by U.S. Border Patrol agents and ICE. He is wanted in El Salvador for the heinous rape of his 12-year-old family member — a crime he committed before illegally entering the United States. This predator thought he could hide in plain sight. He was located and arrested without incident and is now in removal proceedings.

USBP remains relentless — doing the heavy lifting to track down fugitives and bring justice to those who prey on the innocent.
